reference: Pitch notes. We're targeting the SMB market — companies with 10 to 500 employees. The problem: expense reporting takes an average of 4.3 hours per employee per month. At an average SMB size of 80 employees, that's 344 hours of lost productivity per company per month. Pricing is $25 per seat per month, with a 10-seat minimum. Current ARR is $430K — we closed an enterprise deal last week. Growing at about 15% month over month, which projects to roughly $6 million ARR by end of year if we maintain that rate. Biggest competitors are Expensify and Concur. We differentiate on integrations — we connect to 48 different accounting systems versus Expensify's 12. Our NPS is 72, which is best in class for the category.
